predictions.reasoning: OpenAI is private, so the most liquid public proxy for an AGI-progress signal is the AI compute/infrastructure complex, led by Nvidia. A sharp rise in the implied probability of OpenAI declaring AGI would signal accelerating frontier-model capability, which the market tends to read as bullish for GPU demand. However, an actual AGI claim is more of a narrative/hype catalyst than a near-term earnings driver, so the 12h reaction is likely modest and noisy, well below the 700bps tradable threshold. Direction is only weakly positive because 'AGI achieved' headlines also raise regulatory, existential, and disruption fears that can offset the compute-demand read.

predictions.reasoning: Microsoft is OpenAI's largest strategic backer and the closest listed vehicle to OpenAI value, making it the natural single-name proxy. But an AGI announcement is deeply ambiguous for MSFT: it could boost the value of its OpenAI stake and Azure AI franchise, yet also trigger governance disputes, an AGI clause that alters the Microsoft-OpenAI commercial relationship, and macro/regulatory disruption fears. Given these offsetting forces and the highly speculative, long-dated, low-base-rate nature of the market, the net 12h direction is genuinely unclear and the expected magnitude is small.

llm_justification.summary: The market prices whether OpenAI formally declares AGI before 2027. Since OpenAI is private, the only public expressions are indirect proxies — Nvidia/AI-compute complex for capability sentiment and Microsoft for stake value. A sharp rise in the implied probability would weakly favor AI-thematic names, led by NVDA, but the signal is speculative, low-base-rate, and ambiguous (AGI headlines also raise regulatory and disruption fears). Expected 12h moves are small and below the tradable threshold, so this is a low-confidence monitoring case rather than an actionable signal.
key_assumptions: A sharp probability move reflects genuine information rather than thin-market noise or a single large bettor
Public markets read AGI-progress signals primarily through the AI compute and Microsoft channels
No dominant offsetting macro event occurs within the 12h window
failure_modes: The prediction-market move is pure hype/thin liquidity and carries no real information, so no asset reacts
The move reverses quickly as skepticism sets in, especially given the extreme claim
AGI headline is net-negative for equities via regulatory/existential/disruption fears, flipping the assumed direction
Proxies (NVDA, MSFT) are too weakly and indirectly exposed to a private-company announcement to move materially in 12h
Any information is already public/priced by the time the market probability shifts
